sources.snippet: SlangGuard A continual-learning MLOps system for Indonesian sentiment analysis. When the language in new data changes (drift), the system retrains the model with LoRA + replay, so it learns new slang without forgetting old data.

sources.snippet: The evaluation focuses on comparing the proposed hybrid model with baseline and ablation variants, including IndoBERT-only, IndoBERT combined with handcrafted features, IndoBERT combined with TF-IDF–SVD features, and the full hybrid model with and without controlled semi-supervised learning.
